Akhalkalaki Jewish Cemetery/Jewish Section within Municipal Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Akhalkalaki, Georgia

Demolished. This record shows two serious data problems worth flagging explicitly rather than silently resolving. First, an internal contradiction: the narrative's opening claims a well-preserved, fenced, protected cemetery, while the record's own classification and site-condition notes say the opposite — demolished, overbuilt, with no gravestones recorded and no information about even its former location. Second, everything after that opening sentence describes a different town's history entirely: Akhaltsikhe, a separate and much better-documented Jewish community elsewhere in Samtskhe-Javakheti, not Akhalkalaki. No genuine historical narrative for Akhalkalaki itself survives in the source data; what's certain is only that this cemetery is now classified as demolished and overbuilt, with no gravestones remaining.
